files.rationale: PR A already wires useCursor's hideCursor into a hidePreviewControls callback passed as hideControls (plus laser pointer, zoom and style props), which fully covers PR B's hide-mouse-and-action-bar intent, so PR A's prop list is kept and B's redundant hideCursor prop is dropped.

Kept PR A's props and its eye-closed 'Hide controls' button (which hides both the action bar and the cursor, the same behavior PR B adds) and dropped B's duplicate hideCursor prop, hidePresentation callback and second eye-closed button so the toolbar does not get two identical actions.
